why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the Forks page Open the Forks page to see which friendly forks are marked Live and which are still to come, and to view the points leaderboard.
2 Step 2 : Pick an independent frontend Liquity runs no frontend itself, so choose one from the list on the frontends page and connect your wallet there.
3 Step 3 : Get BOLD You mint BOLD by borrowing against ETH or staked ETH collateral, as described on the Borrow page .
4 Step 4 : Use BOLD in a listed venue The Earn page lists Stability Pools and outside venues where BOLD earns fork rewards. Deposit into one of them.
5 Step 5 : Check your leaderboard position On the Forks page , use the check-your-position button under the leaderboard to see your points and your share of the total.

6 Step 6 : Claim Enosys rewards on Flare Network For Enosys, the Enosys announcement says rewards are claimed on its frontend on Flare Network. The Forks page does not describe claiming for the other forks.
